notes.title: Subterraneus is now better than ever!
notes.content:
Subterraneus is now Better than Ever!
The 1.1 update is officialy live!

So, what's new?
- New price: 8$!
- Extended help system to provide full help with multiple levels of hints! You won't be blocked anymore! At least, I hope so!
- Steam achievements! Go get them! Who will be the first to get the 100%? Well, me off course! But beside me ? Who will it be? Maybe YOU!
- Enhanced graphics! Because it's always better when it's better. (Yes, I know, it's deep philosophy)
- In-game collectibles! An occasion to learn more about Subterraneus characters in a very briefly way!
- New gameplay options! Is there to many interest points for you ? There is an option! You have a highly disruptive environment and you don't want to miss a single word of dialogues? There is an option! (and thank you, it's means a lot to me!) You want to win at the lottery? Well, there is no option for that... But I wish you the best!
- bugfixes! All of the bugs I could find have been fixed!
- brand new bugs! Hopefully not, but If you encounter any of them, please tell me!

If you want to help me, then you can play the game, leave a review on Steam or tell your friends about Subterraneus!
Any help for spreading the word is very appreciated! 😄

Thank you all!
